app.title: Knowledge base
login.title: Sign in
login.claim: Answers from company documents. With a footnote to the page.
login.error.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
history.label: Conversations
history.no_sources: Sources and footnotes are not available for answers from earlier sessions.
history.unknown_base: I don't know which knowledge base this conversation used, so I can't show its documents. Follow-up questions go to this conversation's base. To choose documents, start a new chat.
chat.welcome.title: What would you like to ask?
chat.welcome.text: I answer from documents in the selected base and show where every piece of information comes from.
chat.question: Question
chat.placeholder.first: Ask about documents in the selected base
chat.disclaimer: Answers may contain mistakes. Check them in the sources.
scope.none: Select at least one document in the Documents panel to ask a question.
base.label: Knowledge base
base.switch.title: New chat in {base}?
base.switch.text: A conversation is tied to one knowledge base. The current chat stays in history.
format.label: Answer format
format.question: How should the answer look?
format.remember: I'll remember this for your next questions.
docs.title: Documents
docs.unknown_base: I don't know which base this conversation used. Start a new chat to see and choose documents.
docs.empty: This base has no documents enabled for search.
docs.footer: Selected documents are the search scope of this conversation.
wait.long: This will take longer – searching long documents.
wait.stopped: Stopped. The system may still finish the answer – it will then appear in history.
answer.no_sources.base: I didn't find this in the documents of {base}.
answer.no_sources.selected: I didn't find this in the selected documents.
answer.no_sources.text: The answer below comes from the model's general knowledge – check it yourself.
answer.coverage.selected: Based on {used} of {total} selected documents · fragments: {fragments}
answer.approx_note: A footnote points to the document; the page is picked automatically, so it may be approximate.
answer.no_citations: The model didn't mark sources in the text – below are the documents the answer is based on.
answer.feedback.label: What was wrong?
answer.feedback.sent: Thanks. Your comment will reach the team.
doc.empty: This part of the document has no text.
doc.extracted: Text extracted from the file – layout and images may differ from the original.
copy.question: Question
error.no_access.title: You don't have access to any knowledge base.
error.no_access.text: Ask your administrator for access, then refresh the page.
error.unavailable.title: The service is temporarily unavailable.
error.unavailable.text: Try again in a few minutes.
error.timeout.title: The answer didn't arrive.
error.timeout.text: The system didn't respond in time. Try again or ask a shorter question.
error.forbidden.title: No access.
error.forbidden.text: You don't have permission to use this knowledge base.
error.auth.title: Session expired.
error.no_documents.title: No documents selected.
error.no_documents.text: Select at least one document in the Documents panel.
error.backend.title: Something went wrong.
error.backend.text: Try again. If the error repeats, report it to your administrator.
error.document.title: The document is unavailable.
error.document.text: It was removed from the base or excluded from search.
error.session.title: Session expired
error.copy: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
